faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad is 28th August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE/BTech/ME/MTech/MS/MCA/MSc degree and have qualified in GATE (CS, DA, EC, or EE) or NET (Computer Science and Applications, Electronic Science, or Mathematical Sciences).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the Government of India/IIT (ISM) Dhanbad norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 37,000 + 20% HRA per month for the first two years, and Rs. 42,000 + 20% HRA per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves merit-based shortlisting followed by an interview, which will be conducted via video conferencing.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT (ISM) Dhanbad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad is located in Dhanbad, Jharkhand, with the pincode 826004.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the JRF position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad on or before the last date. Details are provided in the "How to Apply" section.
